caption: A brittle cavalry squadron (blue) facing west is caught on its left flank by a spear block marching up from the south, breaks while still in contact and flees north, with the spearmen following at the edge of their reach. As it crosses that edge, the point its formation is laid out from moves once, from its front ranks to its whole block, and stays there. Before this fix the move toward the whole block carried that point back inside the spearmen's reach, so it went back to the front ranks twice and away again, swinging up to 1.2 m off the line it now follows.
